question: On s032's 5-cell bracket, does the cell-filter aggregate score pick the closest-to-truth-|omega| cell, supporting a rank-then-densify architecture?
hypothesis: Cell-filter survivor count or score correlates with cell-to-truth distance, so cells can be ranked and the top-K densified.
narrative_md: On s032's cached 5-cell bracket (81 seeds), the highest-max_geo cell equals the closest-to-truth-|omega| cell on 71.6% of seeds (+258% over the 20% random baseline); top-2 by max_geo_align_sum catches it on 97.5%. No fast-tail degradation (Q4 71%); Q2 anomalously weak (50%). Caveat: 4/5 cells are usually grossly off-truth so the lift is partly elimination-by-mismatch (tested directly in s047b). Picks the closest-to-truth cell, so it reads truth as input.
